jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Onion production manual

varieties.name: Red Creole
varieties.supplier_notes: Standard Kenyan red onion; pungent, stores 3-4 months.

varieties.name: Texas Grano
varieties.supplier_notes: Larger bulb, milder; better for fresh market not long storage.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed thinly in raised nursery bed at 1cm depth.
Plough and level land. Incorporate 2 tons well-rotted manure per acre.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima na sawazisha shamba. Changanya tani 2 za samadi iliyooza.

timeline_template.description_en: Transplant 6-8 week seedlings at 10cm x 15cm. Trim roots and tops by 1/3.
timeline_template.description_sw: Pandikiza miche wiki 6-8 nafasi 10cm x 15cm. Punguza mizizi na ncha.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100kg DAP at planting, well-mixed into soil.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 100 za DAP wakati wa kupanda.

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed carefully — onion roots are shallow.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwa mkono kwa makini — mizizi ni juujuu.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for thrips at first sign of silvery streaks.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya thrips ukianza kuona michirizi yenye rangi ya fedha.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout for thrips (silvery streaks) and downy mildew (pale patches) weekly through bulbing.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza vidukari wadogo na ukungu kila wiki wakati wa kutengeneza vitunguu.
Dosi ya pili ya CAN wakati kitunguu kinaanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest to cure bulbs.
timeline_template.description_sw: Acha kumwagilia wiki 2 kabla ya kuvuna.

timeline_template.description_en: Pull bulbs when tops fall over and yellow. Cure in shade 1 week.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuta vitunguu majani yakianguka. Hifadhi kivulini wiki 1.

timeline_template.description_en: Cure necks 2–3 weeks in dry shade before storage — this step doubles the storage window.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kausha shingo wiki 2–3 kivulini kabla ya ghala — hatua hii inakuza muda wa kuhifadhi.
timeline_template.tip_en: Cured onions keep 3–6 months; uncured ones rot in weeks.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vitunguu vilivyokaushwa hudumu miezi 3–6; visivyokaushwa huoza ndani ya wiki.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: 50g+ firm bulb, dry neck. Grade B: 30-50g. Reject soft or sprouted.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 50kg mesh bags for wholesale; 10kg net bags for retail.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Dry well-ventilated shed at 0-5°C lasts 6 months. At room temp, 2-3 months.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Banda kavu lenye hewa 0-5°C miezi 6. Joto la kawaida miezi 2-3.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery streaked leaves, stunted plants, worst in dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yenye michirizi ya fedha, mimea dhaifu, zaidi wakati wa kiangazi.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered product only at threshold; they multiply fast in heat. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa tu wakati wamezidi; huongezeka haraka jua kali. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza kila wiki; epuka mkazo wa ukame.
diseases.scanner_notes: Silvery streaks on leaves are the signature.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pale patches on leaves, grey-purple fuzz, cool damp spells; leaves die back and bulbs stay small.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meupe majani, ukungu wa kijivu, baridi na unyevu; majani hufa na vitunguu kubaki vidogo.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered downy-active fungicide at first patches. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya ukungu mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotate crops, open rows for airflow, avoid leaf wetness.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mazao, nafasi kwa hewa, epuka majani kuloweshwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Leaf close-up; fuzz on the leaf surface.

diseases.symptoms_en: Purple-brown lesions with yellow halos, leaf dieback, bulbs rot in storage.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya zambarau yenye mpaka wa manjano, majani hufa, vitunguu huoza ghala.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered alternaria-active fungicide at first lesions. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya alternaria mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotate crops, remove debris, keep tops healthy to harvest.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mazao, ondoa mabaki, weka majani imara hadi kuvuna.

diseases.symptoms_en: Soft grey rot at the neck entering storage; bulbs collapse weeks after harvest.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Uoza laini wa kijivu kwenye shingo ghala; vitunguu huoza wiki baada ya kuvuna.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure post-harvest — curing is the control. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba baada ya kuvuna — kukausha ndio dawa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Cure necks 2-3 weeks in dry shade before storage; store dry.
diseases.prevention_sw: Kausha shingo wiki 2-3 kivulini kabla ya ghala; hifadhi pakavu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Post-curing bulb photo; ask about curing time in-app.

diseases.severity_classes: Patchy (wilting patches) · Severe (fluffy rot, stand loss)
diseases.symptoms_en: White fluffy fungal growth on bulb bases, small black sclerotia, plants yellow and wilt in patches.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Ukungu mweupe kwenye msingi wa vitunguu, madoa meusi madogo, mimea hunyauka kwa mapande.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — remove and destroy infected plants and soil around them. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze mimea na udongo wa karibu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotate long away from onion and garlic; clean tools.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mashamba mbali na vitunguu; safisha vifaa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the bulb base — the white fluff is the diagnosis.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Cured onions store 3–6 months — sell into the lean months instead of the harvest glut. The curing step doubles your storage window.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Vitunguu vilivyokaushwa huhifadhi miezi 3–6 — uza wakati wa uhaba, si wakati wa mavuno mengi. Kukausha kunakuza muda wa kuhifadhi.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Wholesale ~30–60 KES per kg (November 2026). Price rises as the stored national supply thins — the farmer who cures well sells at the top.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Bei ya jumla ~30–60 KES kwa kilo (Novemba 2026). Bei hupanda wakati hifadhi ya taifa inapopungua — mwenye kukausha vizuri anauza bei ya juu.
